### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

Problems: P-root = customer applies the replacement to the December night; P1 = reissue of the replacement; P2 = return of the original award from the relocated stay. P-root waits on P1, P1 waits on P2. Order P2 → P1 → P-root.

- **P-root → P1 (state-derived).** Blocked-side sentence (replacement_award_hold): "A replacement award's hold is not placed until the replacement stands issued in the member's account carrying the reference of the award it replaces." Records: `find_free_night_certificates` shows no award with `replaced_certificate_id: cf42b0e1…`. Searching "replacement", "reference of the award it replaces" leads to replacement_award_deposit: "A replacement is of the same type as the award it replaces, carries the reason that it replaces an earlier award and that award's reference", capability "status issued … a link to the award it replaces". Write found. Why a replacement and not the original: the original's expiry passed (R5) and the relocated-return doc says it is "usable for no stay"; eligibility "Validity: The night covered must fall on or before the award's expiry date".
- **P1 → P2 (state-derived).** Blocked-side sentence (replacement_award_deposit): "A replacement's expiry date is set only after the award it replaces stands back in the member's account with its return from the relocated stay entered in its history." Records: `cf42b0e1…` `status: applied`, no release record for `557f37b4…`. Searching "return", "relocated" leads to relocated_reservation_award_return: "When the hotel relocates a Reward Night Rate reservation, every award on it comes back to the member's account, and its return record states the walked-night protected price", capability "the award's status becomes issued again … one return entry is added". Write found. Reissue rule clause 1 also reads "The release, its reason and its date … from the award's history".
- **P2 → nothing.** relocated_reservation_award_return carries no prerequisite sentence.
- Pre-solved check — candidate flagged for Step 3b: relocated_reservation_award_return says the expired returned award stands returned "so that its replacement can be deposited against it". It was not needed to derive the hop (the deposit doc's own sentence suffices), but it is a sentence in the depended-on document that states what the dependent problem does with the returned award. I mark the hop **state-derived**, with this sentence noted for the dependency-form scan.

### Two-way counter-proof

- **Closest alternatives excluded.** (i) Apply the original 85K after return with the returned-award tool: its expiry passed (R5; "usable for no stay"), and the returned-award rule is for an award "that came back from a cancelled stay". (ii) Use `3e414e94…`: customer's exclusion; not the Maui award. (iii) Refuse because a reissue already happened: limit counts replacements "carry[ing] this award's reference"; `16c54608…` carries `11cfa1e2…`. (iv) Replacement validity 3 months: schedule gives 6 for 85K. (v) Same-day-number expiry: Premier convention at ≥50 credits. (vi) Very-hotel or other-brand walk protection: hotels differ (MUIRS vs PSRSP), brand is the same. (vii) An earlier hold as "latest hold": the 2026-04-11 hold for the walked night is the most recent. (viii) Delay ≤ 60 days: 94 days. (ix) Third relocation posting: 2024-07-05 is outside 24 months.
- **"Do only the one thing the customer asked" excluded.** No replacement carrying `cf42b0e1…`'s reference exists, so "no hold of a replacement award is placed"; the replacement's expiry date cannot be set while the original "does not stand back in the member's account with its return from the relocated stay entered in its history". The original itself cannot pay the night (expired). Both exclusions come from blocked-side sentences plus records.
- **Fall-backs.** Return 70000 (≠ 34000); expiry 2027-04-05 (≠ 2028-04-30); hold 42000 (≠ 28500). Factor documents were reached from record words: `relocated_date` vs the return date (delay docs), `relocation_compensation` postings, `elite_night_credits`, tier `variant_name`, `nights` on the relocated / new reservation, `stay_nights` credit rows, `enrolled_date`, `cobrand_card`, `award_season`, and the hotel/brand fields. No computation document hinted at a variation.
